title: Scoped Multipass transport validation

actions.permission: A human security operator may activate only the target-specific bridge100 exception required for Multipass control to the named disposable guest.
actions.expected_effect: Host 192.168.252.1 can reach guest 192.168.252.5 on TCP/22 without guest internet access or a broader host-control change.

test.method: Run a fresh Multipass control probe to the named guest and independently observe that only the approved target path is reachable.
test.expected_result: The exact guest control probe succeeds and no other guest, subnet, port, protocol, route, firewall, VPN, or network-extension exception is introduced.

actions.stop_condition: Stop before activation or execution on any target-binding mismatch, broader rule, credential request, guest-internet enablement, retained-validator impact, or unexpected collateral effect.

actions.permission: The human security operator may remove only the exact exception activated under ACT-001 at completion, expiry, failure, or collateral-effect detection.
actions.expected_effect: The approved temporary exception is absent and the prior host security-control posture is restored without changing the disposable or retained guest.

test.method: Inspect the exact target-specific rule and the surrounding firewall, VPN, route, and network-extension state after removal.
test.expected_result: The temporary target rule is absent, prior controls remain present, and no unrelated state changed.

actions.stop_condition: Stop and preserve evidence if removal would affect any other rule, target, credential, guest, route, firewall, VPN, or network-extension state.

prohibited_changes: Global disablement or weakening of a network extension, firewall, VPN, route, or isolation control
An exception for any other guest, host, interface, address, subnet, port, protocol, or application traffic
SSH key, password, token, certificate, signer material, or other credential creation or regeneration
Retained azpr-validator mutation, startup, deletion, reconfiguration, or use as the disposable target
Frozen candidate, prompt, dependency, wheelhouse, historical evidence, or preserved mapping mutation
Formal verifier execution, environment qualification, INT-00 progression, materialization, controller activation, provider activation, staging, or production activity

evidence.purpose: Preserved human-supplied authority handoff and scope boundary
Pre-repair transport failure and target context
Non-authoritative repair diagnostics and current target fingerprints
Governing H0 single-writer and authority boundary

notes: This ticket does not approve the Linux environment, a verifier result, INT-00, mapping materialization, either controller, a provider, staging, or production.
No execution may start until a trusted authentication adapter binds an APPROVED decision to the canonical ticket SHA-256.
Approval, execution run, evidence bundle, and outcome record remain separate records linked by immutable IDs.
